Self.Wiki: Environment map effect box (vanilla names: Env_BoxNNN). Applies the env map captured at the Env_Point region with the box's env map number, and links to the GIIV irradiance volume with that number.

DisplayDistance.Wiki: The distance from camera required before enabling envmap. 0 = always enabled.

FadeDistance.Wiki: The distance it takes for an envmap to fully transition into view.

ParallaxCorrection.Wiki: Applies parallax correction to the env map when on. On in one retail box.

LegacyPriority.Wiki: The box priority for MSB versions before 0x38 only. Every retail map with boxes is newer and uses Priority instead; this is 10 in every retail box.

EnvMapNumber.Wiki: The env map number this box uses: it applies the env map of the Env_Point region with that number (Env_Point015 for 15) and links to irradiance volume GIIV 0015. -1: the three digits at the end of the box name (Env_Box015 is 15). The box name must be exactly Env_BoxNNN and the point name exactly Env_PointNNN for the name lookup to work.

BoundsExpandNegative.Wiki: Extends the box's influence bounds beyond its shape on the negative X/Y/Z sides, in its local frame (min = -size/2 - this). 0 in retail.

BoundsExpandPositive.Wiki: Extends the box's influence bounds beyond its shape on the positive X/Y/Z sides, in its local frame (max = size/2 + this). 0 in retail.

AmbientSpecularIntensity.Wiki: Multiplies the brightness of the box's specular (reflected) light. 1 = as baked. Older Smithbox versions showed this value as the diffuse intensity.

AmbientDiffuseIntensity.Wiki: Multiplies the brightness of the box's diffuse light. 1 = as baked. Older Smithbox versions showed this value as the specular intensity.

UnkT2C.Wiki: Which light the box gives: 0 = specular and diffuse, 1 = diffuse only (the reflection cubemap is not loaded), 2 = specular only (the irradiance volume is not loaded); any other value works like 0. 0 in retail except two boxes (1).

UnkT2D.Wiki: Copied along with the Unknown: 0x2C flags but never read, so it has no effect in ER. 0 in retail.

IsModifyLight.Wiki: Affects lighting with other fields when true. Possibly normalizes light when false.

UnkT2F.Wiki: Passed to the irradiance volume setup, which never reads it: no effect in ER. On in 4171 of 5189 retail boxes.

AdditionalEnvMapNumber.Wiki: A second env map / irradiance volume number for this box. When 0 or more, the game runs the volume setup a second time with it. -1: none. Retail: -1 in 5046 boxes; others use values such as 900, 901, 902 and 405.

UnkT32.Wiki: Passed to the irradiance volume setup, which never reads it: no effect in ER. On in 12 retail boxes.

UnkT33.Wiki: Passed to the irradiance volume setup, which never reads it: no effect in ER. On in 5047 of 5189 retail boxes.

Priority.Wiki: The box priority (MSB version 0x38 and later, which is every retail map with boxes). Retail values include 10, 20, 30, 21, 31 and 22.

UnkT36.Wiki: Passed to the irradiance volume setup (MSB version 0x3F and later; older versions pass on), which never reads it: no effect in ER. On in nearly every retail box.
